title: Desert - Vanilla Expanded
description: A mod that adds vanilla friendly desert biomes and features
body:
# Vanilla Expanded
Vanilla Expanded Desert is a part of the Vanilla Expanded Modpack. This mod focuses on creating 2 desert/arid biomes with additional blocks, mobs, and structures. The main goal of this mod, and the modpack as a whole, is to create a vanilla friendly overworld update in the style of an offical mojang update.
## Biomes
- Dry Forest (Baobab)
- Oasis (Palm)
## Blocks
- Full Baobab wood set
- Full Palm wood set
## Mobs
- Ostrich
- Bearded Dragon
## Structures
- Sorghum Farm
- Sand Castle
## Other Features
- Sorghum crop
- Syrup
- Pancake
